1) New package cn.yuanxin.mvp.web.assessments.narration with:

a. MockReportNarrationGenerator (@Component, @Conditional(NonProductionCondition.class)). Class javadoc MUST state in Chinese: MOCK 联调数据/文案生成器——固定数据，非正式算法结果，不调用算法/RAG/AI，不读取密钥；仅供报告播报 SSE 联调. Contains the fixed mock region JSON verbatim as a constant:
{"regions":{"F":{"O":{"score":40,"label":"较明显"},"P":{"score":62,"label":"轻度"},"D":{"score":81,"label":"未见明显"}},"L":{"O":{"score":35,"label":"较明显"},"P":{"score":28,"label":"较明显"},"D":{"score":55,"label":"中度"}},"R":{"O":{"score":70,"label":"轻度"},"P":{"score":82,"label":"未见明显"},"D":{"score":50,"label":"中度"}},"C":{"O":{"score":20,"label":"显著"},"P":{"score":50,"label":"中度"},"D":{"score":65,"label":"轻度"}}}}
Parse with Jackson; per-region score = arithmetic mean of that region's O/P/D "score" values, rounded HALF_UP to integer → F:61, L:39, R:67, C:45. Region display names: F→额头, L→左脸, R→右脸, C→下巴 (fixed order F,L,R,C). Build narration text programmatically from names+computed scores using template: "本次完成{F名}、{L名}、{R名}和{C名}四个区域的皮肤检测。" + "{F名}{F分}分，{L名}{L分}分，{R名}{R分}分，{C名}{C分}分。" The full text MUST equal EXACTLY (byte-for-byte):
本次完成额头、左脸、右脸和下巴四个区域的皮肤检测。额头61分，左脸39分，右脸67分，下巴45分。
Expose the text split into exactly 2 delta chunks: chunk1="本次完成额头、左脸、右脸和下巴四个区域的皮肤检测。" chunk2="额头61分，左脸39分，右脸67分，下巴45分。" (derived from the template, not separately hardcoded). No timers/delays/threads in the generator.

b. ReportNarrationStreamController: @GetMapping("/api/v1/skin-assessment-tasks/{taskId}/report-narration-stream", produces=MediaType.TEXT_EVENT_STREAM_VALUE), returns ResponseEntity<StreamingResponseBody>, params: @PathVariable UUID taskId, PrincipalContext principal, plus ObjectProvider<MockReportNarrationGenerator> (or the generator injected as ObjectProvider) and AssessmentReadService, and an ObjectMapper for event data JSON.
Pre-stream checks ON THE REQUEST THREAD, in order (all failures → existing ApiException/GlobalExceptionHandler JSON envelope with real HTTP status):
  1. principal.principalType() != GIMBAL → ApiException(ErrorCode.CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED) (403), mirror AssessmentController.requireGimbal message style.
  2. generator ObjectProvider empty (production fail-closed) → ApiException(ErrorCode.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE) (503).
  3. AssessmentTaskView view = assessmentReadService.getTask(taskId, principal) (yields 404/409 internally).
  4. view.reportId() == null → ApiException(ErrorCode.RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE) (404) — report not ready; mirror SkinReportService not-ready wording.
Then return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(MediaType.TEXT_EVENT_STREAM).cacheControl(CacheControl.noStore()).body(stream) where stream writes events (writeEvent-style framing + flush after EVERY event; capture requestId=principal.requestId(), taskId, reportId=view.reportId() in the closure — MDC does not propagate to the async thread):
  - event "start", data JSON {"requestId":...,"taskId":...,"reportId":...,"seq":1}
  - event "text_delta" ×2, data {...,"seq":2,"delta":"<chunk1>"} then {...,"seq":3,"delta":"<chunk2>"} (key order: requestId,taskId,reportId,seq,delta; use a LinkedHashMap/record + ObjectMapper so JSON is valid single-line)
  - event "done", data {...,"seq":4}
  Terminal discipline: exactly one of done|error. "error" event only if an unexpected RuntimeException occurs mid-stream before done: data {...,"seq":<next>,"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"报告播报生成失败"} (safe fixed fields only — never leak exception details/stacks). Client disconnect (IOException on write/flush) → stop quietly, end this send. NO Last-Event-ID/resume/persistence/replay/cancel API. seq starts at 1, strictly +1 per event.

2) New docs catalog class cn.yuanxin.mvp.web.docs.catalog.ReportNarrationStreamDocs implementing ApiDocsCatalog — mirror GimbalAiDocs bean gating and structure exactly: key "GET /api/v1/skin-assessment-tasks/{taskId}/report-narration-stream", exactly one tag, Chinese summary (e.g. 测肤报告文案播报流（MOCK）) and Chinese description that MUST disclose: 本接口为 MOCK 联调增量——返回固定联调数据生成的报告播报文案，非正式算法/RAG/AI 结果；事件 start/text_delta/done/error，data 含 requestId/taskId/reportId/seq（text_delta 另含 delta）；不支持 Last-Event-ID/断点续传/重放；catalog-only（按用户授权增量，不入 contracts/openapi.yaml）; success doc SuccessDoc.binary("200", <描述含 Content-Type text/event-stream、Cache-Control no-store、事件顺序>, "text/event-stream"); errorCodes list: CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED(403), RESOURCE_NOT_VISIBLE(404), TASK_REPLACED(409), DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE(503) — plus mirror whatever 401 codes GimbalAiDocs/AssessmentApiDocs declare for ***REDACTED*** Path variable taskId must be documented (mirror existing entries' parameter docs).   - Test B (single rejection scenario): APP principal session token → same GET → assert 403 and JSON error envelope with code CALLER_NOT_ALLOWED (pre-stream problem JSON, Content-Type application/json).

148:         String description = full ? textOrNull(payload.get("description")) : null;
149:         List<Map<String, Object>> metrics = full ? projectMetrics(payload.get("metrics")) : null;
150:         List<SkinReportImage> images = projectImages(payload.get("images"));
151:         String memberId = full && row.memberId() != null ? row.memberId().toString() : null;
152:         String readyAt = row.reportReadyAt() == null ? null
153:                 : EnvelopeSupport.rfc3339(row.reportReadyAt());
154:         String planStatus = accessRepository.planStatusByAssessmentId(row.id()).orElse(null);
